title: Regulatory T Cells and Immune Suppression in the Tumor Microenvironment
text: Regulatory T cells accumulate in the tumor microenvironment where they suppress effector immune response and promote tumor immune evasion. We show that Treg depletion enhances the efficacy of anti-PD-1 therapy in preclinical models. However, systemic Treg depletion causes severe autoimmunity, highlighting the need for tumor-selective approaches. The interplay between Treg recruitment and cytokine gradients such as CCL22 and TGF-beta remains poorly understood. Selective Treg modulation in the tumor microenvironment warrants further investigation.
